You know him through the Berlin trilogy. Door: Scary Monsters (and Super Creeps) (1980). Path: Outside (1995, a murder-mystery concept album with Eno) → Heathen → The Next Day → Blackstar.
Door: The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967). Path: White Light/White Heat → The Velvet Underground (1969) → Loaded → Reed's Transformer → Berlin → New York.
Door: Horses (1975). Path: Radio Ethiopia → Easter → Wave → Gone Again. A Rimbaud-obsessed poet fronting a rock band.
You know After the Gold Rush and Sugar Mountain. Door: On the Beach (1974). Path: Tonight's the Night → Rust Never Sleeps → Everybody Knows This Is Nowhere → Harvest → Freedom.

Door: Hounds of Love (1985). Path: The Kick Inside (with "Wuthering Heights") → The Dreaming → Aerial.

Door: Remain in Light (1980). Path: 77 → Fear of Music → Stop Making Sense → David Byrne & Brian Eno's My Life in the Bush of Ghosts.

You've tried the ambient records; his song albums are a different animal, closer to Talking Heads and Bowie's Low. Door: Another Green World (1975). Path: Here Come the Warm Jets → Taking Tiger Mountain (By Strategy) → Before and After Science.
You know them all.
Door: The Kinks Are the Village Green Preservation Society (1968). Path: Something Else → Arthur → Muswell Hillbillies. Ray Davies is pop's Dickens.
Door: Exile on Main St. (1972). Path: Beggars Banquet → Let It Bleed → Sticky Fingers.
Door: The Piper at the Gates of Dawn (1967) for Syd Barrett, then Wish You Were Here (1975). Path: The Dark Side of the Moon → Animals (Orwell's farm, rewritten) → The Wall.

Door: Sign o' the Times (1987). Path: Dirty Mind → 1999 → Purple Rain.
Door: Nebraska (1982). Path: Born to Run → Darkness on the Edge of Town → The Ghost of Tom Joad (Steinbeck's ghost, literally).

Door: Dummy (1994). Path: Portishead → Third.
Door: Mezzanine (1998). Path: Blue Lines → Protection.
Door: Homogenic (1997). Path: Debut → Post → Vespertine → Medúlla.
Door: good kid, m.A.A.d city (2012). Path: To Pimp a Butterfly → DAMN. → Mr. Morale & the Big Steppers. The closest thing hip-hop has to a great American novelist.
Door: Odelay (1996). Path: Mellow Gold → Mutations → Sea Change → Morning Phase.
Door: Songs for the Deaf (2002). Path: Rated R → ...Like Clockwork.

Door: Curtis (1970). Path: Super Fly → There's No Place Like America Today.
